segments.contextAfter: `presenting`: The view controller that is presenting the view controller in the `presented` parameter. The object in this parameter could be the root view controller of the window, a parent view controller that is marked as defining the current context, or the last view controller that was presented. This view controller may or may not be the same as the one in the `source` parameter. This parameter may also be `nil` to indicate that the presenting view controller will be determined later.
